title: Stress a greener dispatch against its reliability contract
description: Choose a workload and carbon strategy, then inject forecast error, capacity loss, or a network partition. An admission guardrail can reject a greener plan before it consumes the job's required completion reserve.

workloads.label: Daily analytics rollup
workloads.detail: 420 kWh, 2h runtime, due in 12h with 1h of required reserve.

workloads.label: Financial close aggregation
workloads.detail: 600 kWh, 3h runtime, due in 5h with 1.5h reserve; modeled as home-region only.

workloads.label: Recommendation refresh
workloads.detail: 900 kWh, 4h runtime, due in 8h with 2h reserve; cross-region execution is approved.

strategies.label: Run now at home
strategies.detail: Zero planned delay at a modeled 420 gCO2e/kWh.

strategies.label: Wait 4 hours at home
strategies.detail: Temporal shift only, targeting a modeled 210 gCO2e/kWh slot.

strategies.label: Move to the approved secondary
strategies.detail: One hour of planned staging, modeled 120 gCO2e/kWh, plus data-transfer energy.

scenarios.label: Forecast and capacity hold
scenarios.detail: The modeled intensity, capacity, and network assumptions remain available.

run-now-home.note: Home capacity is available at the baseline intensity.

wait-home.note: The job starts after four hours at the forecast home-region intensity.

move-secondary.note: The approved secondary has capacity and the transfer path is available.

scenarios.label: Grid forecast is too optimistic
scenarios.detail: Actual intensity is higher than forecast; completion timing is unchanged.

run-now-home.note: The run-now baseline is 60 gCO2e/kWh higher than modeled.

wait-home.note: The expected low-carbon home slot arrives 160 gCO2e/kWh higher than forecast.

move-secondary.note: The secondary region is 180 gCO2e/kWh higher than forecast, reducing the expected benefit.

scenarios.label: Target capacity is delayed
scenarios.detail: Queueing consumes deadline margin, especially in the secondary region.

wait-home.note: The planned home slot starts two hours late and at a slightly higher intensity.

move-secondary.note: Secondary capacity starts five hours late, consuming most or all completion reserve.

scenarios.label: Cross-region network partition
scenarios.detail: Home-region execution remains available, but the secondary cannot receive the dataset.

run-now-home.note: The home path does not depend on the failed inter-region link.

wait-home.note: Temporal shifting remains local and does not cross the failed link.

move-secondary.note: The scheduler cannot stage data or dispatch the job to the secondary region.

guardrails.label: Enforce placement and reserve
guardrails.detail: Before dispatch, fall back to run-now home if the path is unavailable or leaves less than the required completion reserve.

guardrails.label: Optimize carbon without a guard
guardrails.detail: Attempt the selected plan even when placement or completion reserve is unsafe.
